caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular box with a hinged lid, shown in a three-quarter view. The surface of the box is decorated with a textured, light brown pattern resembling woven fibers. Across the top and sides of the box, there is an illustration of orange and red flowers with green centers, as well as dark green leaves and blue-green stems. The floral design spans the edges, connecting the lid to the main body of the box. A small, yellow, metal-looking latch is situated at the center on the front side, holding the lid closed. The background of the image is plain and off-white, with some minor brown speckling. The edges of the box are outlined in black, emphasizing its shape and structure.
title: Glove Box
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
